name: TheMealDB
tagline: Free recipe and meal database API for meals, ingredients, and categories
description: TheMealDB is a free open recipe database with a REST API for searching meals by name, ingredient, category, or area; looking up full recipes with instructions and images; listing categories and random meals. Popular with developers for demos and food apps. Free test key is available; premium paid keys unlock higher limits.

auth.details: API key in URL path as /api/json/v1/{API_KEY}/... Free test key is 1. Premium keys available via Patreon/subscription.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free test API key "1" with limited access; premium paid keys via Patreon for higher limits (exact limits not fully published on main docs)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium API key via TheMealDB Patreon/subscription

example.response_snippet: {"meals":[{"idMeal":"52771","strMeal":"Spicy Arrabiata Penne","strCategory":"Vegetarian","strArea":"Italian","strInstructions":"Bring a large pot of water to a boil...","strMealThumb":"https://www.themealdb.com/images/media/meals/...","strIngredient1":"penne rigate","strMeasure1":"1 pound"}]}

use_cases: look up full recipe with ingredients and instructions
list meal categories or random meal ideas
